# Spellcasting Improvement Foundation (2026-07-12)

Session goal (user): **improve** holtburger-web spellcasting — war + void magic in
particular. NOT a revamp: the existing system was hard-won; fix what's broken, tighten
what's loose. Symptoms reported:

1. "Things aren't animating properly — the arms aren't always rising when they should."
2. "Movement breaks animations."
3. "It seems you can run as far as you want and cast spells wherever you want."

This document is the shared foundation for a 16-workstream Opus fan-out. It was
assembled by direct reading of both codebases (not agent hearsay); every file:line was
opened this session. Baseline: `external/holtburger` @ `6fcff2f0` (clean tree), live
vanilla ACE on this laptop (udp 9000/9001), `pkg/` wasm release-build fresh as of
2026-07-11.

Paths: `HOLT = apps/holtburger-web` (repo-relative), `DECOMP = /home/wbterminal/ac-headers`,
`LSD = external/LSD-Partial-2025-02-23_16-15`, ACE reference = `external/ACE/Source`
(reference ONLY — never edit `~/ace-server`, keep-ACE-vanilla is a standing user rule).

## 1. How casting works TODAY in holtburger-web (verified 2026-07-12)

### 1.1 Cast entry points (C2S wire = GameAction 0x4A CastTargetedSpell / 0x48 CastUntargetedSpell)

- **Click-to-cast (armed spell)**: `HOLT/scene3d/picking.js:602-702`. In Magic stance
  (stance low16 == 0x0049, the only retail magic stance — `index.html:2855`) with
  `window.__combatBarState.armedSpellId` set, a click on an entity fires
  `turnToFaceThenAct(guid, doCast, CAST_FACE_TARGET)` → `sessionHandle.castTargetedSpell(guid, spellId)`
  → local prediction `em.playCastSequence(localGuid, spellId)`.
  `castFaceTarget` is default-ON (`picking.js:51-54`).
- **Plugin/hotbar path**: `HOLT/plugins/api.js:451-490` `castSpell(spellId, targetGuid)` —
  null target resolves self-target via `ui/ac_cast_spell.js::selfTargetGuidFor` (ACE
  untargeted 0x0048 never broadcasts TargetEffect, so self-spells are PROMOTED to
  targeted at own guid — live-verified 2026-07-01). Also calls `playCastSequence` (F8-3).
- **Hotbar armed-spell-on-item bridge**: `HOLT/plugins/hotbar.js:641-670`.
- Wasm sends: `src/lib.rs:32631-32665` (castTargetedSpell / castUntargetedSpell) →
  `SessionCommand::CastTargetedSpell` → `lib.rs:44241-44262` GameAction pack.

### 1.2 The LOCAL cast animation = a JS wall-clock chain (NOT the Rust motion authority)

`EntityManager.playCastSequence(guid, spellId)` — `HOLT/scene3d/entities.js:6728-6912`:

- Looks up `data/spell-cast-sequence.json` (6,266 spells; generated by
  `scripts/gen-spell-cast-sequence.cjs` from spells-catalog + spell-components +
  spell-shapes + LSD spells.json, algorithm mirrors ACE `SpellFormula.GetGestureMotionsList`).
  Entry shape: `{windupGestures:[{motion:"0x10000132", name, durationS}], castGesture:{motion:"0x40000035",...},
  fastCast, leadOnly, casterEffect, targetEffect, formulaScale}`.
- For each windup then the cast gesture: `setSwingMotion(g, motionU32, {speed: CAST_SPEED})`
  then `setTimeout(durationS*1000/CAST_SPEED)` sleeps pace the chain (`entities.js:6783-6831`).
  `CAST_SPEED` = 2.0 default (F8-1, ACE CastSpeed=2.0; `entities.js:896-910`).
- Cancellation = monotonic `inst._castSequenceToken`; recast preempts. F8-4 busy window
  `inst._castBusyUntilMs` (capped 12s) gates spam recasts (`entities.js:6764-6772`);
  cleared by UseDone (`index.html:7851-7860`) / fizzle / cancel.
- On chain completion, emits synthetic `playEffect {targetGuid: caster, scriptId: casterEffect,
  speed: formulaScale}` → play_effect_vfx resolver (`entities.js:6884-6908`).
  **TargetEffect is NOT synthesized locally** (attribution TODO at `entities.js:6865-6877`).
- Fizzle: WeenieError 0x0402 arrives via kind=13 → `em.cancelCastSequence(localGuid)`
  (`index.html:7828-7842`, castFizzle default-ON). The wasm re-emits spell WeenieErrors as
  kind=13 + retail toast strings (`lib.rs:20765-20804` — fizzle/mana/components/range/
  moved-too-far/air strings verified verbatim vs decomp).
- `cancelCastSequence` bumps the token and recoils to stance-Ready 0x0003
  (`entities.js:6927-6939`).

### 1.3 `setSwingMotion` = three.js one-shot OVERLAY, gated on a wasm MotionTable LINK

`entities.js:7138-7330`:

- stance = `inst.currentStance ?? inst.lastStance ?? window.__getCurrentStanceLow?.()`.
- `classifyMotionCommandTyped(mtableId, stance, cmd)` (`entities.js:2272-2330`) calls wasm
  `lookupMotionLinkForSwing`; plays ONLY if `kind ∈ {swing,cast}` AND `resolvedCommand != 0`
  AND `source === "wasm-link"`. **Any miss = SILENT NO-OP** (the setSwingPose vibe-pose
  fallback was retired 2026-06-18 WS-B). ⚠ The wasm path is also skipped entirely when
  `stance` is falsy (`entities.js:2277` requires truthy stance).
- On hit: `animationCache.get(...,{fromMotion: READY_SUBSTATE})` bakes the link clip; plays
  LoopOnce clampWhenFinished=true at `(clip.duration/durationSec) * _motionSpeed * opts.speed`,
  OVERLAYS the locomotion (FU-3: full-body unconditional), and
  `_suppressBaseCycleForOverlay` (`entities.js:9831-9869`) zeroes the base cycle's weight,
  restoring it on the mixer `finished` event **only if `_locoCycleKey` still maps to the
  same action**.
- MotionTable data shape (validated across all 436 retail MTs): swings + casts live in
  `links[(stance,Ready)][fullCmd]`, never in cycles — `entities.js:7797-7818`. Link inner
  key = FULL 32-bit command (C3 finding); `expandActionCommandLow16` (`entities.js:2223-2238`)
  reconstructs classes for bare low-16 (0x6F..0x78 & 0x11F..0x134 → 0x10-class; 0x16..0x39 → 0x40).

### 1.4 Locomotion + the cast/movement animation interplay (JS)

- `setMotion` (`entities.js:7615-8130`): attack/cast classes route to `_tryPlayLink` as
  overlays and RETURN (locomotion untouched, `lastMotionCommand` NOT updated); locomotion
  cycles crossfade via `AnimationCache` keys; Stop/0x0 substitutes Ready; stance=0
  preserves `lastStance`; wire Left cmds fold to Right (retail parity).
- Local input drives TWO lanes (both fire `em.setMotion` on the LOCAL rig):
  - Legacy lane (`?cmdInterp=off`): W3.1 block `index.html:9107-9194` — every input-sig
    change plays the forward base clip AND (castMove, forward-edge-only) cuts an in-flight
    cast chain via `cancelCastSequence` (busy-window-guarded).
  - Interpreter lane (**default ON** since 2026-07-03): raw key edges →
    `handle.handleKeyAction`; renderer consumes wasm ClientEvent kind=61
    (`index.html:8085-8177`): code 1 ForwardSlotEvicted → cast anim-break cut,
    code 3 DriveApplied → forward base clip + sidestep overlay.
- **Movement arbitration during casts is ALREADY PORTED in Rust** (the 2026-07-02/03
  castMove/slideCast/cmdInterp waves; read `docs/url-flags.md` rows `castMove`, `slideCast`,
  `cmdInterp` — they carry the full retail citations):
  - Autonomy latch (`last_move_was_autonomous`, retail SmartBox::SetObjectMovement
    acclient.c:311185-311193): server-authored cast gestures LOWER it; every local key
    EDGE raises it. Latch LOW → interpreted (server-echo) state drives; the gesture holds
    the single FORWARD slot at zero locomotion (SLIDECAST); a forward edge evicts it
    (FASTCAST anim-break). Per-axis edge merge (2026-07-03). `?slideCast` default OFF
    (authentic burst; `=on` = held strafe survives stomps — live-validated 14.96m
    continuous slide vs 0.05m).
  - `crates/holtburger-core/src/client/movement/` — `command_interpreter.rs` (per-axis
    CommandLists, FU-A TakeControl, FU-C silent releases), `motion_table_manager.rs`
    (retail pending-anims queue; **completion-clock shim**: no renderer AnimationDone
    route yet, so 1-anim nodes complete on AUTHORED length, fallback 2.0s
    `RENDERER_DONE_FALLBACK_SECS` — module doc lines 1-130 is required reading),
    `motion_interp.rs`, `system.rs`.
  - ⚠ KNOWN GAP (url-flags cmdInterp row, verbatim): "vanilla-ACE General cast stomps
    never transfer control (the FU-A-dormant finding), so live cast legs keep the
    tap-revive feel until the wire-side control migration" — and the use_time pump
    "reclaims held keys after the gesture's node drains WITHOUT a tap". With a
    multi-windup war spell this means held-W movement revives between windups. This is
    the prime suspect for symptom 3 ("run as far as you want").
  - ACE server-side only rate-checks casts; the 6.0-unit fizzle circle (`Windup_MaxMove`)
    applies to **PK players only** (ACE `Player_Magic.cs` DoCastSpell: PhysicsObj position
    delta check under `IsPKType`). Non-PK on vanilla ACE = no server movement penalty.
    Retail matched this. So "cast while running far" is part vanilla-ACE reality, part
    client arbitration gap — improvements must keep authenticity (no invented hard roots).

### 1.5 Server echoes & remote casters (wire → render)

- ACE echoes every windup/cast gesture to the CASTER and broadcasts to observers via
  UpdateMotion 0xF74C (`EnqueueMotionMagic` WorldObject_Networking.cs:1078 — General
  case-0, EMPTY axes, one stomp per windup).
- wasm KIND_MOTION (kind=5): locomotion `forward_command` only; ACTION-class commands are
  FILTERED OUT of the locomotion slot (`lib.rs:40906-40934`) and surfaced as
  KIND_MOTION_ACTION (kind=8) with 15-bit stamp dedup (`lib.rs:41222-41297`), played for
  EVERY guid **including local** via `loop.js:_armMotionAction` (`loop.js:2585-2627`)
  → `em.setMotion` → cast/attack overlay.
- Echo-vs-prediction dedup: `noteLocalSwingPrediction` is called from the cast chain only
  when `CAST_SPEED !== 1.0` (`entities.js:6812`) and consumed under `?dispatchParity`
  (default ON) at `loop.js:2605-2610`.
- MOTION_AXES side-channel (`?castAxes`, default ON): remote sidestep/turn during cast →
  `setSidestepLayer` strafe overlay + turn-in-place (AUDIT-casting-ingredients.md).
- ⚠ DEAD BRANCH: `dispatchRemoteSwing`'s magic-stance arm (`index.html:8654-8659`) still
  calls `em.setCastPose(g)` — **retired to a no-op 2026-06-18** (`entities.js:6666`).
  Remote caster gestures now depend ENTIRELY on the UpdateMotion action path. Whether
  that path reliably raises remote casters' arms (multi-windup chains, stamp dedup,
  stance availability at spawn) is unverified.
- Projectiles: ACE never sends in-flight UpdatePosition for PhysicsState::MISSILE; the
  ONLY motion datum is ObjectCreate PhysicsDesc velocity — parsed
  (protocol `description.rs:1052-1057`) and forwarded for missiles (`lib.rs:39977-40006`),
  integrated ballistically in JS (`entities.js:4019-4045`; `projectileGravity` +
  `projectileArc` default ON). VectorUpdate on impact zeroes it.

## 2. How casting works in RETAIL (decomp ground truth, read this session)

### 2.1 Client-side cast flow (UI → wire)

- `ClientMagicSystem::CastSpell(spellID)` (acclient.c:404671): loads CSpellTable
  0x0E00000E → component-ownership check ("You do not have all of this spell's
  components") → self-flag (`_bitfield & 8`) casts at own id → TargetType 0 → untargeted
  → else requires `ACCWeenieObject::selectedID` + `ObjectCompatibleWithSpell` ("You must
  select a suitable target before casting this spell").
- `ClientMagicSystem::FreeHandsAndCastSpell` (acclient.c:403775): calls a cmdinterp vtable
  op, then `CM_Magic::Event_CastTargetedSpell(target, spell)` (acclient.c:699796; action
  0x4A + OrderHdr UI stamp) and `ClientUISystem::IncrementBusyCount` — the retail
  cast-busy gate is a UI busy counter, decremented when the server's order completes.
- **The retail client does NOT gate range client-side.** The only range math is
  `SpellExamineUI::DetermineSpellRange` (acclient.c:228504-228580):
  `range = _base_range_mod * skillLevel + _base_range_constant` (skill = spell's skill, or
  for non-skill spells max(4 magic skills) clamped by Arcane Lore 0x2B), capped at 75.0
  (RADAR_OUTDOOR_RADIUS). Server rejects out-of-range; client renders the toast.
- Spell-cast error strings live client-side keyed by WeenieError (acclient.c:415960-416030:
  fizzled 0x402 / components 0x400 / mana 0x401 / target missing 0x403 / mislaunch 0x404 /
  "impossible spell path" 0x3FA / outside 0x407 / "You don't know that spell!" 0x3FE /
  "Incorrect target type" 0x3FF / out of ammo 0x3F8 …).

### 2.2 Gesture playback = server-authored movement, SINGLE-PLAYHEAD full-body splice

The retail server sent windups/cast gestures as movement messages; the client applied
them through the SAME machinery as any motion:

- Slot semantics — `RawMotionState::ApplyMotion` (acclient.c:332855-332920) and
  `InterpretedMotionState::ApplyMotion` (acclient.c:332759-332786):
  - class 0x40 (substate — includes the FINAL cast gestures MagicBlast 0x4000002B,
    MagicSelf, MagicPray, Eat/Drink, AimLevels 0x1E..0x39) → **replaces `forward_command`**
    (+ speed). This is why held-W "dies" during a cast gesture.
  - class 0x10 (Action — includes windups MagicPowerUp01-10 = 0x1000006F..0x78 AND the
    colored variants 0x10000128..0x10000131/0x134 band) → **appended to the `actions`
    list** with a 15-bit stamp (AddAction), NOT the forward slot.
  - class 0x20 (modifier) → add_modifier / combine_motion (true concurrent overlay —
    turn/sidestep cycles).
  - class 0x80 (style/stance) → sets style + forces forward Ready 0x41000003.
- `CMotionInterp::move_to_interpreted_state` (acclient.c:344372-344430): copies movement,
  `apply_current_movement`, then walks the actions list with stamp-window dedup
  (`server_action_stamp`, half-window 0x3FFF) → `DoInterpretedMotion` per fresh action.
- `CMotionTable::GetObjectSequence` (acclient.c:337641-337905) — THE composition
  authority. For an Action: find link (style, curr-substate → action); if found:
  `MotionState::add_action` + `CSequence::clear_physics` + `remove_cyclic_anims` +
  `add_motion(action anims)` + `add_motion(current cycle)` + `re_modify`. I.e. the action
  SPLICES IN FRONT of the re-appended cycle on ONE timeline — **full-body one-shot, then
  the cycle resumes**. No per-bone blending. If no direct link: route via style-default
  (Ready): curr→Ready link, Ready→action link, action, back-link, cycle. For a substate
  (0x40): remove cyclic anims, insert transition link(s) (possibly via Ready), then the
  new substate cycle; same-substate speed changes ride `change_cycle_speed`.
  `CSequence` = DLList of AnimSequenceNodes + `first_cyclic` marker + velocity/omega +
  ONE `frame_number` playhead (acclient.h:30747-30758).
- Completion: `MotionTableManager::PerformMovement/add_to_queue/AnimationDone/
  CheckForCompletedMotions` (acclient.c:330206-330260, :329873) — pending-anim queue,
  AnimDone → `CMotionInterp::MotionDone` (:343641); on the local player the pump
  (`UseTime`) re-applies held keys after the gesture's node completes. Our Rust port:
  `motion_table_manager.rs` (see its module-doc divergence contract).
- Jump-during-cast gate — `CMotionInterp::motion_allows_jump` (acclient.c:5279E0 body at
  :343295-343315): jump allowed ONLY when forward substate is Ready-family/aim/magic-gesture
  bands: 0x1000006F-0x10000078, 0x10000128-0x10000131, 0x40000008, 0x40000016-0x40000018,
  0x4000001E-0x40000039, 0x41000012-0x41000014 (i.e. you CAN jump out of windups; jump
  resets the movement lock via LeaveGround → apply_current_movement :344457).
- Autonomy dispatch: `CMotionInterp::apply_current_movement` (acclient.c:344301-344315):
  `movement_is_autonomous` → raw (keyboard) else interpreted (server echo) — the latch
  the castMove port mirrors.

### 2.3 Spell data (client DATs)

- `CSpellBase` (acclient.h:39434-39459): name, desc, school, icon, category, **bitfield**
  (self-flag 8; fast-cast bit per ACE), base_mana/mana_mod, **_base_range_constant /
  _base_range_mod**, power, economy, formula_version, component_loss, SpellFormula
  (8 comps), **_caster_effect/_target_effect/_fizzle_effect (PScriptType)**,
  **_recovery_interval/_recovery_amount**, display_order, non_component_target_type,
  MetaSpell.
- `SpellComponentBase` (acclient.h:40960-40970): name, category, icon, type, **_gesture**
  (MotionCommand), **_time** (per-component windup duration), text, _CDM (burn rate).
  ⇒ retail windup durations come from the COMPONENT TABLE (0x0E00000F), gestures too —
  scarab determines the PowerUp gesture; our JSON durations were derived via ACE. A
  DAT-vs-JSON audit is cheap via the WB.Terminal oracle.
- Fizzle VFX: client only packs/unpacks `_fizzle_effect`; the server triggers it (ACE:
  PlayScript.Fizzle + Sound on WeenieError fizzle). Client plays via 0xF755.

### 2.4 What retail did NOT do (guardrails against over-correction)

- No client-side range gate before sending the cast (server-authoritative; client toast).
- No hard movement root during casts for non-PK; the windup "move too far" fizzle circle
  is a PK mechanic. Slidecast/strafecast/fastcast-anim-break were REAL retail feel —
  already ported (castMove/slideCast). Do not "fix" them away.
- Magic has NO auto-charge/MoveTo — caster stands and casts from wherever he is.

## 3. Symptom → suspect map (each = verified starting point, not a conclusion)

**S1 "arms not always rising":**
- (a) `setSwingMotion` silent no-op lattice: `source !== "wasm-link"` / stance falsy at
  `entities.js:2277` / link lookup miss for (Magic stance, gesture). Void spells use
  COLORED powerups (e.g. 0x10000132 MagicPowerUp08Purple — see spell 2331 in the JSON);
  verify player MT 0x09000001 has `links[(0x49,Ready)]` entries for the colored band, and
  that `lookupMotionLinkForSwing` resolves them (the retail fallback routes an unlinked
  action VIA Ready — our single-link lookup may lack that fallback).
- (b) chain pacing vs async clip fetch: `setSwingMotion` is deliberately not awaited; a
  cold `animationCache` fetch can outlive a short windup sleep (min 50ms) so the gesture
  never visibly plays.
- (c) local echo double-path: chain prediction + KIND_MOTION_ACTION echo; dedup only
  notes predictions when CAST_SPEED≠1.0 and consumes under dispatchParity — races restart
  or half-play clips.
- (d) remote casters: dead `setCastPose` branch (`index.html:8654`), reliance on the
  action echo path; unverified for multi-windup chains.
- (e) busy-window early-return: `playCastSequence` re-entry during `_castBusyUntilMs`
  IGNORES the recast (`entities.js:6766-6768`) — server accepted casts can go un-animated
  if UseDone didn't clear promptly (dropped kind=14, self-cast paths, etc.).

**S2 "movement breaks animations":**
- (a) three.js overlay model vs retail full-body splice: locomotion setMotion mid-overlay
  crossfades a NEW base cycle at weight 1 while the overlay is still weight 1 → three.js
  normalization halves both (visible "mushy" cast); `_suppressBaseCycleForOverlay`'s
  restore is same-action-gated and `_locoCycleKey` may be re-pointed mid-flight
  (`entities.js:7267-7277`, `:9831-9869`).
- (b) the anim-break cut (`cancelCastSequence`) recoils to Ready but the already-playing
  overlay action isn't stopped — verify the visual actually cuts (retail cuts to the
  locomotion cleanly because the spliced sequence is REPLACED).
- (c) two input lanes both driving `em.setMotion` (kind-61 consumer vs legacy W3.1) —
  confirm exactly one is live under the default flag set and that gesture-vs-drive
  ordering can't interleave (e.g. DriveApplied Ready base stomping a cast overlay's
  suppression bookkeeping).

**S3 "run as far as you want / cast wherever":**
- (a) FU-A-dormant + use_time reclaim: held keys revive after each windup node drains
  (motion_table_manager completion shim), so multi-windup casts leak movement without a
  fresh edge. Candidate improvements: complete the renderer AnimationDone notify route
  (`?mtQueue` lane is landed but dormant — no JS play site tags `mtQueued`), and/or hold
  the reclaim while the wasm knows a cast chain is in flight (needs a client cast-state
  signal the Rust side can read).
- (b) no pre-cast range/target feedback: implement flag-gated CLIENT-side range preview
  (SpellExamineUI formula) + clearer server-reject toasts. Keep the send authoritative
  (retail didn't gate) — feedback, not prohibition, unless the user later rules otherwise.
- (c) if "cast wherever" includes indoor/outdoor-only spells: 0x407/0x408 toasts exist —
  verify they render.

## 4b. Dev-community lore (Discord archive, mined 2026-07-12 — corroboration, not spec)

- **Remote caster turn IS wire-driven**: "the client is told to animate the movement of
  someone turning to another person when a person is casting a spell on them" (bosh
  scranson, decalinfo 2025-04-25). Confirms WS06/WS07: the server sends the caster's
  TurnTo; observers render it. War-detect plugins literally watch for "someone turning
  at you with spell words".
- **Cast completion signal**: "0x01C7 action complete — ACE sends it for spell casting
  to be done" (Shem, acmanager 2021-02-10) — matches our UseDone kind=14 lifecycle.
- **Projectile aiming**: "PvP arrows / spells don't track right, so you could detect the
  start of a casting / missile animation and strafe one way then immediately strafe the
  other when the projectile is released" (trevis, 2023-01-27) — the projectile aims at
  the target's position at RELEASE, not at windup start; dodge-timing is a real mechanic.
  Launch-time targeting parity matters for WS10.
- **Anim-break culture**: "animation break cycle mashing would get a full spell ahead and
  get out of combat and war you while emoting" (bosh, 2025-04-30); "server cant detect
  animation break" (Morosity, 2019); "fastcast + animation break" (hydra, 2025). The
  break is purely client-visual — reinforces the castMove design (server only rate-checks).
- **ACE has a recoil-queue dial**: `spellcast_recoil_queue: if true, players can queue
  the next spell to cast during recoil animation (default False)` (Hells, 2025-10-11) —
  relevant to WS08/WS14 recast feel; our live server is vanilla (default False).
- **GDLE as retail-feel reference**: "I worked hard on GDLE movement/casting to ensure it
  was retail like, why people love the pvp on gdle more" (Vanquish420, 2026-04-11 — the
  same person whose PvP casting/movement work the community called retail). GDLE C++ is
  a legitimate CROSS-REFERENCE for casting/movement semantics (read-only; the no-PhatSDK
  rule means never port its code, only compare behavior).
- **Slidecast is the community's ACE grievance**: "slidecasting is something that's
  completely fixable that ACE refuses to" (bosh, 2025-04-30) — already the basis of our
  `?slideCast` work; an alt-client isn't credible "unless video shows me slidecasting"
  (phenyl, 2026-03-22). Casting feel is THE credibility bar for this client.

## 5. Validation recipes

- Serve: `python3 external/holtburger/scripts/serve.py` → :8765; URL
  `http://127.0.0.1:8765/apps/holtburger-web/index.html?nosw=1&...`.
- Headless bot: `?nosw=1&nullRender=1&renderOnDemand=1&netDrainHz=30&autoLogin=1&account=X&password=X&autoSpawn=first&kickDance=1&agent=1`;
  poll `window.__bootState==='in-world'`; drive casts via
  `window.__sessionHandle.castTargetedSpell(guid, spellId)` /
  `window.__pluginClient` api; observe `__diag.wire.summary()`, console.
- Known-good test spells (LSD ids): war bolt chain — arm via combat-bar or call directly;
  Wedding Bliss 1708 = 3-windup self chain (used for the slideCast live validation);
  spell 2331 = single Purple windup + MagicTransfer. Pick war I bolts (low mana) for the
  test char; void needs a void-trained char (check `playerKnownSpells()`).
- The per-workstream acceptance bar: bare-default URL loads, spawns, casts, 0 console
  errors, and the specific symptom's repro script shows the fix; flag-off arm byte-identical.
